title: The target: work on it here
question: This is the screen we are building towards. Steer it in your own words - what to change, add or take away - and I will redraw it and put the new version back on this page. The build follows whatever this settles into.

options.label: The nutrition screen
options.thesis: One soft white material, the tubes lit from inside with the empty part left neutral, a coloured glyph and a halo behind each icon, and the write-line as the one lit bar.
options.viewport: Tubes, water, three meal rows, the lit write-line, the tab bar.
options.risk: Two things in this drawing the app does not have: an icon per meal row, and a meals list that is exactly three fixed rows. Both are real work, not CSS.
